doc: Authoritative kernel test / benchmark cases of PithTrain. Generated by `python -m tools.kernel_cases --write`; do not edit. See docs/kernel-validation.md.

moe_experts.doc: Routed experts of one EP rank: gate_up and down grouped GEMMs (fwd, dgrad, wgrad) in FP8 and BF16, the fused activation (+ quantization) between them, and the token movement around them.
moe_experts.axes: T (tokens per GPU), ep, G = E / ep local experts, top_k, hidden, inter, act, bias, routing, group_sizes (rows per local expert; the FP8 path pads each to a multiple of 128), bf16_fused (G <= 64)
moe_experts.reference: per-group float64 (BF16) or fp32 of the exactly dequantized FP8 operands, written in the test
moe_experts.tolerance: FP8: calc_diff and a per-element bound against the exact-dequant reference; BF16: half a bf16 ulp + 1e-5 x sum |products| (tests/spec/test_spec_moe_experts.py)

dense_gemm.doc: FP8 dense linears (training.Linear with fp8=True): y = x W^T, dgrad and wgrad, with the activation / gradient quantizations, at M = tokens per GPU.
dense_gemm.axes: M (= tokens per GPU), N, K, projection name
dense_gemm.reference: fp32 matmul of the exactly dequantized operands; quantizations bit-exact against the E8M0 recipe
dense_gemm.tolerance: calc_diff and per-element bound vs exact dequant; bf16-truth calc_diff (tests/spec/test_spec_dense_gemm.py)

weight_quant.doc: FP8 weight quantization and the FP8 parameter all-gather, per rank's weights.

attention.doc: FlashAttention-4 launches as training makes them: dense causal at CP 1 and the three zigzag ring-step launches at CP > 1 (step 0 causal over the local 2 blocks; front: all local q over the remote front block, a strided k / v view; back: the local back-block q view over the remote 2 blocks), plus packed varlen at CP 1.
attention.axes: kind (dense | ring_diag | ring_front | ring_back | varlen), B, Sq, Skv, Hq, Hkv, D, Dv, causal, window, sinks, cu_seqlens
attention.reference: fp32 attention computed in query blocks, with a hand-written fp32 backward (not FA4), random dout

ring_attention.doc: The CP ring operators end to end on cp GPUs: ring_attention_func / mla_ring_attention_func at the production S_local, fwd and bwd.
ring_attention.axes: cp, B, S_local, Hq, Hkv, D, Dv, mla
ring_attention.reference: fp32 full causal attention of the gathered sequence, in query blocks (not FA4)
ring_attention.tolerance: relative L2 error per output (tests/spec/test_spec_ring_attention.py, multigpu)

gated_delta_rule.doc: Gated DeltaNet at the folded head counts (batch folded into the heads): the pinned kernels at CP 1, the CP pieces at CP > 1.
gated_delta_rule.axes: cp, mbs, T_local (= seq / cp), H = key heads x mbs, HV = value heads x mbs, K = V = 128
gated_delta_rule.tolerance: calc_diff per output and max-abs vs the reference's largest magnitude

causal_conv1d.doc: Qwen3.5's channels-last causal depthwise conv over the mixed q / k / v channels.
causal_conv1d.axes: B (= mbs), T_local, C, width, cp (conv state from the previous rank when cp > 1)
causal_conv1d.tolerance: half a bf16 ulp of the fp32 result plus fp32 accumulation slack

cross_entropy.doc: The lm_head loss on the last pipeline stage: rows = tokens per GPU, the full vocab.
cross_entropy.reference: float64 log-softmax, gradient through the CrossEntropy autograd op with a grad_output that is not 1
cross_entropy.tolerance: loss rel 1e-6; gradient within one bf16 rounding of the exact value

swiglu_dense.doc: SiLU-mul of the dense and shared-expert MLPs at M = tokens per GPU (eager silu_mul kernels; FP8 runs the fused fp8_silu_mul with one group).

pointwise_layers.doc: The torch-compiled per-token layers around attention and the experts (no pithtrain kernel; Inductor-generated): RMSNorm, q/k norm, RoPE (partial for Qwen3.5), router top-k.
pointwise_layers.axes: T, hidden, heads x head_dim, rotary_dim, E, top_k
